_platform_note: The keys above are the macOS reference values, kept as the defaults so nothing about that machine changes. `launch_<platform>` and `crossbackend_launch_<platform>` are merged over them by sys.platform, which is how the same configs.json drives the Linux box: different binary path (no .app bundle), different mod directory, and a different screenshot directory (M_GetScreenshotsPath is $HOME/.config/gzdoom/screenshots on Unix, ~/Documents/GZDoom/Screenshots on macOS).
_scenes_note: Selected with --scene. The default scene needs a third-party mod and a savegame, neither of which travels between machines -- the savegames are per-machine files and the pk3s are large downloads. The doom2/doom1 scenes need only a stock IWAD and a map name, so they run anywhere, including CI, and they cover the bare-IWAD path that the mod scenes never touch. Maps are chosen for content, not convenience: a mostly-enclosed room gives the postprocess passes something to act on. NOTE doom2 uses MAP12 rather than MAP01 deliberately -- see the GL black-frame open item in AGENTS.md; MAP01/02/03/04/06/07/09/10 currently render as an all-black frame on OpenGL and would make every config compare black to black. Switch this to MAP01 once that is fixed, since it is the better regression target.

configs.name: baseline
configs.note: Every optional pass off. The thing everything else is measured against.

configs.name: ssao
configs.note: Reference PP AO. Composited nothing at all until 2026-08-06.

configs.name: bloom_compute
configs.note: Metal compute bloom. Agreed with bloom_ref to max_delta 1 on 2026-08-07, so it is NOT declared must_differ_from bloom_ref -- see tolerance.

configs.name: tonemap_identity
configs.note: gl_tonemap 4 is sqrt(c*c) == c, a mathematical identity. It MUST reproduce the baseline exactly, and tonemap_uncharted proves the pass is capable of changing pixels -- both halves are required.

configs.name: lens
configs.note: gl_lens 1, one draw. Rendered upside down until 5a9b53e1b.

configs.name: fxaa
configs.note: gl_fxaa 1, two draws. Its evenness is why it accidentally survived the V-flip bug.

configs.name: colormap
configs.note: Not a cvar -- a palette flash from an item pickup. Fires in ordinary play and flipped the whole screen until 5a9b53e1b.

configs.name: custom_pp_identity
configs.note: Custom postprocess shader at pptest_scale 1.0 is an identity, so it must reproduce the baseline. Requires tools/pptest/make.py to have been run. Never executed AT ALL on Metal until 25fbdc24b.

configs.name: custom_pp_half
configs.note: The other half of custom_pp_identity: at 0.5 the same shader must visibly darken, or the identity above is just 'the pass never ran'.
